definitions.name: G0A.SUM
definitions.note: sum of a numeric Vector as a bare scalar

definitions.name: G0A.MEAN
definitions.note: arithmetic mean of a numeric Vector

definitions.name: G0A.DEVS
definitions.note: Vector of each element minus the mean

definitions.name: G0A.NORM
definitions.body: 'G0A.NX' BIND G0A.NX G0A.NX G0A.MIN - G0A.NX G0A.RANGE /

definitions.name: G0A.WORDS
definitions.note: split a String on single spaces into a Vector of words

definitions.name: G0A.CAP1
definitions.body: CHARS 'G0A.TW' BIND G0A.TW [ 1 ] TAKE JOIN UPPER G0A.TW [ 1 ] DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: upper-case the first letter of one word String

definitions.name: G0A.UNWORDS
definitions.body: [ 'G0A.JW' BIND ' ' G0A.JW 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN CHARS [ 1 ] DROP JOIN
definitions.note: join a Vector of Strings with single spaces

definitions.name: G0A.TITLE
definitions.note: title-case every word of a space-separated String

definitions.name: G0A.ACRONYM
definitions.body: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS 0 GET ] MAP JOIN UPPER
definitions.note: upper-cased first letters of every word
